Markets.title: Same playbook, different numbers: Why FPI selling may not be the story it looks like
Markets.summary: Indian equities fell due to rising crude prices, US Treasury yields, geopolitical risks, and foreign portfolio investor (FPI) selling. Despite this broad market decline, foreign investors selectively continued buying Indian IPOs, debt, and mid-cap and small-cap stocks.

Markets.title: J Infratech files IPO papers; eyes Rs 600 cr via fresh issue
Markets.summary: Haryana-based infrastructure firm J Infratech has filed preliminary papers for an initial public offering to raise Rs 600 crore through a fresh issue and promoter offer for sale. The company plans to use the proceeds to support working capital and repay its borrowings.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: 23,270 is a key Nifty hurdle; Sudeep Shah picks 5 stocks, discusses PB Fintech, Turtlemint strategy
Markets.summary: Nifty closed at 23,140.50 following its eighth consecutive weekly decline amid bearish technical indicators and global market pressures. Analysts note that 23,300 acts as a key resistance level while 23,000 serves as options-based support, with Pharma and Healthcare showing relative strength.

Markets.title: Bitcoin rebounds strongly this week, trades near $84,000 after climbing above $86,000. Here is what experts say
Markets.summary: Bitcoin rebounded this week to trade around $84,000 after briefly climbing above $86,000. The 3.6% weekly gain was driven by positive ETF flows and reduced uncertainty following the US Federal Reserve's September policy decision.

Markets.title: Nifty at key 23,000 support: Can bulls trigger a technical rebound?
Markets.summary: The Nifty fell 0.88% to 23,140.50, extending its losing streak to seven weeks amid bearish momentum. The market is now watching the critical 23,000 to 23,200 support zone to see if buyers can spark a technical rebound.

Markets.title: FIIs, MFs raise stakes in 10 stocks; shares gain up to 40% in 3 months
Markets.summary: During the June 2026 quarter, Foreign Institutional Investors and mutual funds increased their holdings in ten Nifty 500 stocks. Following this institutional buying, these shares gained up to 40% over the next three months.

Geo-Political.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump has rejected a proposed deal from Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. Tehran acknowledged Trump's rejection and stated it is awaiting the definitive views of regional mediators.

Geo-Political.title: Pope praises young people's 'energy and commitment' at huge open-air Mass in Paris
Geo-Political.summary: Pope Francis praised the energy and commitment of young people during a large open-air Mass in central Paris. The religious event drew a crowd of approximately 700,000 attendees.

Geo-Political.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
Geo-Political.summary: A suspected gas explosion in a building near the Acropolis in Athens has killed six people. The victims include a British national, four Americans, and one Greek national.

Geo-Political.title: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
Geo-Political.summary: A town in Germany has banned "stumbling stone" brass plaques that memorialize victims of the Nazi regime. The country's education minister has strongly criticized the ban, calling it a scandal.

Geo-Political.title: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
Geo-Political.summary: A powerful nor'easter has triggered flooding for tens of millions of residents from Maine to Virginia. In response to the severe storm, officials in New York and New Jersey declared states of emergency.

Geo-Political.title: Republic of Ireland to wear black armbands for Israel game
Geo-Political.summary: The Republic of Ireland football team plans to wear black armbands during their upcoming match against Israel. Players will wear the armbands to recognize all lives lost in the Gaza conflict.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in digital marketing from traditional search engine optimization to artificial intelligence optimization.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: Artificial intelligence tools have become essential for digital creators looking to stay ahead in 2025. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to revolutionize and simplify the content creation process.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: Sitharaman on India’s 10%+ growth potential: Startups and technology can drive next phase
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman stated that startups and technology can help India achieve over 10% economic growth. She noted that reaching this higher growth level requires significant effort from all sections of society to advance the goals of Atmanirbhar Bharat and Viksit Bharat.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex fall by $14.9 billion in a week, says RBI: Where do reserves stand now?
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $14.9 billion in a single week, according to the Reserve Bank of India. This sharp decline was primarily driven by a decrease in foreign currency assets, which make up the largest component of the country's reserves.

Data & Insights.title: India's financial, external sectors remain resilient despite global risks: RBI bulletin
Data & Insights.summary: According to the RBI Bulletin, India's financial and external sectors remain resilient despite global risks. This economic strength is supported by strong Q1 growth, high foreign direct investment, robust exports, and $765.9 billion in foreign exchange reserves.

Data & Insights.title: CEA flags US friction, energy shocks, and missing AI play as India’s key near-term risks
Data & Insights.summary: Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran stated that trade coercion, weaponized supply chains, and rising US bond yields are key near-term risks for India. He warned that these global pressures require the country to adopt a costlier hedging strategy and a new economic playbook.

Data & Insights.title: India’s growth outlook strengthens as economists see resilient incomes, stable policy: WEF
Data & Insights.summary: According to a WEF survey, 74 percent of economists expect India's economic growth to be strong or very strong over the next year. This improved outlook is driven by resilient domestic demand and stable policy expectations.

Data & Insights.title: Centre lowers FY27 borrowing estimate by  ₹1.2 trillion, plans  ₹7.86 trillion bond sales in H2
Data & Insights.summary: The central government has reduced its fiscal year 2027 borrowing estimate by ₹1.2 trillion due to stronger tax and non-tax receipts. It will conduct ₹7.86 trillion in bond sales during the second half of the year.

India.title: Tyre Burst, Then Over 100-Metre Skid: BJP MLA Has Narrow Escape On UP Highway
India.summary: BJP MLA Chandrapal Singh had a narrow escape when his Toyota Fortuner suffered a tyre burst and skidded over 100 meters on the Ganga Expressway before crashing into a pole. He was subsequently taken to a hospital for treatment.

India.title: Judicial System Has Long Focused On Accused And Offence, Says Chief Justice
India.summary: Supreme Court Justice Surya Kant stated that India's judicial system has historically concentrated on the accused and the offense rather than victims. He made these remarks during the inauguration of a Victim Rights Centre at the Bihar State Legal Services Authority.

India.title: Man Killed During Clash Between 2 Political Groups In Bengal's Medinipur
India.summary: A man was killed during a clash between two political groups in Medinipur, West Bengal. Local residents stated the victim was associated with the BJP, though the party's district president denied this claim.

India.title: 'Judiciary Committed To Protecting Students' Right To Protest': Chief Justice
India.summary: During an interaction with students at Chanakya National Law University in Patna, the Chief Justice of India stated that the judiciary is committed to protecting the right of students to protest. He expressed his preference for frank question-and-answer sessions by engaging in an unfiltered conversation with the attendees.

India.title: Pilot Body Seeks Scrutiny Of Technical Records In AI-171 Crash Probe
India.summary: The Federation of Indian Pilots has requested that investigators closely examine technical records related to the AI-171 crash. These documents, provided by the Foundation for Aviation Safety, include details on the aircraft's maintenance history, recurring system issues, and operational background.

India.title: Ex-Kerala Chief Secretary Claims Gyanesh Kumar Offered Him BJP Ticket In 2016
India.summary: Former Kerala Chief Secretary Jiji Thomson claimed that Gyanesh Kumar offered him a BJP ticket in 2016. This allegation emerges while the Election Commission and Kumar face intense controversy regarding electoral roll revisions and internal panel disputes.

General.title: Burnham announces scheme to help first-time buyers on to housing ladder
General.summary: Prime Minister Burnham has announced a new housing scheme to assist first-time buyers. The program is specifically designed to help people who lack financial support from their parents.

General.title: Faisal Islam: The two big calls the chancellor has to make ahead of the Budget
General.summary: The UK Chancellor faces two major decisions in the upcoming Budget regarding ongoing economic pressures from the Iran war. He must also determine how to maintain modest economic optimism moving forward.

General.title: Court of Appeal overturns ban on Drumcree parade
General.summary: The Court of Appeal has overturned the ban on the Drumcree parade after the Portadown District Orange Lodge declined a request to postpone it. Judge Patricia Smyth had previously asked the lodge to delay the march along the Garvaghy Road.

General.title: Heathrow Airport warns third runway could be delayed by four years
General.summary: Heathrow Airport warns that the construction of its proposed third runway could be delayed by up to four years, potentially missing the government's 2035 completion target. Government ministers have responded by stating that this original deadline has always been ambitious.

General.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
General.summary: President Trump rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days in exchange for a deal. Iran's foreign minister stated that Tehran is currently waiting for the definitive views of mediators regarding the situation.
